claims.summary: The Russian numeral девяносто means 'ninety'. Its declension is simpler than many other numerals, having a form for nominative and accusative (девяносто) and another form (девяноста) for genitive, dative, instrumental and prepositional.

In nominative, девяносто is used and the counted noun appears normally in genitive plural. In accusative, девяносто is also used. In genitive, dative, instrumental and prepositional, девяноста is used with plural counted noun.
Provides examples of девяносто used in nominative, genitive, dative, instrumental and prepositional cases with different counted nouns.
